subject: How do I use indProd() function in SEM with latent interaction?

messages.author: f640e564e17265a2
messages.subject: How do I use indProd() function in SEM with latent interaction?
parts:
Hello together,

I would like to run a moderated mediation with two times of measurement. My Model is attached.

I assume, that DV1 (Degree of Virtuality) predicts Health at both times of measurement (H1 and Ha2), mediated by Trust (T1 and T2 measured at time of measurement one and two). Additionally I assume Shared Leadership (SL1) to be a moderator of the connection between DV1 and T1/T2. My model is built like Hayes Model 7.

As DV1 and SL1 are both latent variables, measured by 12 items (DV1) and by 20 items (SL1), I used indProd() function to create the products of the items. Then I could define my interaction term using the products of all the items.

My Problem is: The indProd() function creates lots of products because of 12 and 20 items of the two variables.

My question is: How do I exactly use the indProd() function in my syntax of the sem? Maybe I did it the wrong way.

Somehow my Computer can not run the model. I received a lavaan Error: Lavaan Error: cannot allocate vector of size 1.6 Gb

It would be so great, if you have any suggestions how to fix the problem.

Thank you so much in advance for your help!

Best, Eva
